svg.title: First-Month Portfolio Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-month-portfolio-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: First-Month Portfolio Roadmap; subtitle: Capital, cheap sourcing, theme gating and a capped listing engine; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Fund the Ledger and Model the Bad Year; deliverable: Starting capital set on the GoDaddy Domain Academy $500 challenge model, with a downside case built from three sales totaling $9.4K that left $900 profit before a $4K trademark dispute (Ownerly); gate: Generic terms only, since trademark terms invite UDRP filings (POWERS Pod); week: Week 2; title: Source Closeouts Every Day; deliverable: Mid-day searches of $1-$50 GoDaddy closeouts (Mike Zigger) and about $5 Dynadot closeouts versus $10-20 elsewhere (Chris Koerner); gate: Registrar appraisals ignored as an anchor; Koerner has seen names sell 99% below Dynadot's appraisal; week: Week 3; title: Gate Hand-Registration Themes; deliverable: 365 days of exact-match godaddy.com search history pulled through Afternic for each theme (Andrew Allemann); gate: Pause any theme where 50 names show no searches; week: Week 4; title: List, Lease, and Cap Every Bid; deliverable: Afternic listings, the venue for 21 of Allemann's 25 sales, plus lease terms at 0.5-1 point per month with a 5-10% option fee (Rosener on Tim Ferriss); gate: Late-bidding bot whose max bid cannot be raised later, and a renewal ceiling priced against cash after $100K into 260-270 names met three dry months; caption: Annual sell-through runs roughly 1-3% of a portfolio, so one or two names carry the year; Allemann logged 8 of 25 sales as lease-to-own deals.; assumptions note: The four-week sequence is an organizing frame; the practitioners did not prescribe a weekly schedule, and all dollar and rate figures are as they reported them.; note: Sources Ownerly (xPtTNJU_OGE @ 00:17:49), POWERS Pod (S9SNhuYObsA @ 00:30:09), GoDaddy Domain Academy (d1VjM9-Tyig @ 00:41:30), Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast (aba_NmtzK1I @ 00:08:07), Andrew Allemann (E4jnQONuo6E @ 00:24:00), Tim Ferriss (ApCGeST90RA @ 01:03:55).
